documentedAdaptations: Shared typography, color tokens, menu labels/routes and larger accessible controls differ from the static source while retaining its full-page anatomy.
Activity context precedes history at 768/390; four actual context facts and the version limitation increase height. At 768 the first event is below the initial viewport.
Preferences exposes supported versioned email settings and explains fixed in-app behavior instead of rendering prototype-only category switches.
Supplemental frames are intentionally scrolled to put their notice, focused detail or disabled action in the viewport.
The shared 768 header abbreviates the role text; no new Notifications-specific overflow was observed.

accessibility.note: Supplemental contrast INCOMPLETE and REVIEW results remain manual follow-ups; UI review explicitly reports approved HTML visual parity NOT_ASSESSED.

limitations: This is a named scoped AI visual review, not representative bank-user or operational acceptance.
The automated review.json field approved_html_visual_parity remains NOT_ASSESSED; this receipt records a separate direct visual review and does not rewrite that report.
Axe reports no violations in the 12 Notifications scenarios, but 80 incomplete color-contrast nodes and supplemental 148 INCOMPLETE / 38 REVIEW readings remain declared limitations.
Synthetic fixtures do not establish live backend authorization, actual email delivery, production readiness or four-actor execution.
The whole-screen acceptance register remains 0/19; this tranche is a partial v2 layout adaptation.
publicationScope: No remote write, new test run, merge or deployment was performed by this reviewer. Ready for normal code review once root publishes this closeout.

Empty inbox notice and zero count are distinct from the invitation to select context; supported search and assigned-work handoff remain visible.
Unavailable notice and Retry notifications are visible in the scrolled phone frame; unread count is not invented and context remains separate.
Failed-read notice is visible beside retained Unread status and the enabled retry action; detail text wraps within the panel.
Older-page failure notice is visible while all five current rows, selection, detail and Load more action remain present.
Selected mobile detail has a visible focus outline, return action, unread status, actual record metadata and readable wrapped heading.
Successful receipt displays Read in row and detail, a disabled Marked as read action, and the fresh server unread count of six.
Conflict notice is visible below retained draft time/timezone/quiet-hour inputs. Values 09:45, 22:10 and 06:20 remain present; recovery controls continue below the viewport.
Permission denial uses an explicit restricted-history message, preserves Inbox navigation and does not expose event rows.
Unavailable history notice and Retry activity are visible with selected scope and unavailable last-checked context; no empty-success message is shown.
Foreign-entity response is rejected into an explicit cannot-confirm-selected-entity error with retry and scope context; no event rows are displayed.
Zero-event state states the selected entity and period and suggests changing period or refreshing; it is visually distinct from failure and permission denial.
Unsupported destination displays a disabled Open record action and explanatory text, with actual reference metadata and the read-versus-work boundary visible.
